final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT orderslink AS ol, AVG(feerate) AS a, AVG(rebrate) AS b FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), s2 AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, AVG(s1.a - s1.b) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM s1 JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = s1.ol JOIN users u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink GROUP BY u.acctscope), s3 AS (SELECT AVG(d) AS m FROM s2) SELECT s2.scope, s2.d, s2.n, s2.d - s3.m AS diff FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.m IS NOT NULL
